comparison.objective: Place a vaccine cool box fully in shade and a solar charger fully in sun.
comparison.physical_skill: Light-and-shadow spatial reasoning plus object transport, not contact-force or impact regulation.
comparison.success_condition: Cool box, including lid, is entirely shaded and charger entirely illuminated; boundary tolerances are referenced only in an unavailable README.
comparison.reason: Tests illumination-aware placement rather than mechanical finishing and fragment recovery.
